_meta.description: SentinelX EasyApply persistent Q&A cache. Every unique form question answered during a LinkedIn Easy Apply session is stored here so the same question is never sent to the Ollama model twice.

schema.entries: Keyed by normalised question fingerprint (see eadump.js fingerprintQuestion). Value holds the resolved answer, source, confidence and usage stats.
schema.visa_policy: Static rules evaluated before any field lookup. If the job location is OUTSIDE India and requires_h1b_sponsorship is true, the sponsorship answer is forced 'Yes'.
schema.location_preferences: Ordered list of preferred work locations. Used to auto-answer 'preferred location' fields without calling the model.

visa_policy.note: Set requires_h1b_sponsorship=true if you need H-1B sponsorship for US roles. The engine uses sponsorship_answer_outside_india for any job whose location is not in India.
